summary.motive: Neutralize man-beating Mesh and shallow cross combinations by freeing an underneath defender (The Rat) to lurk in the short intermediate hole while corners play trail technique.
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses design crossing rub routes expecting defenders to chase from behind; the lurking linebacker sits directly where the receiver crosses.
summary.failureMode: A deep comeback or back-shoulder throw outside the numbers where the underneath rat cannot provide help.

beats.title: Cover 1 Presentation & Mug Illusion
beats.text: Quinn shows a single-high Cover 1 look with MIKE threatening the A-gap, inviting the offense to run a quick Mesh crossing concept to beat the man coverage.

beats.title: The Rat Drops into the Hole
beats.text: Rather than blitzing or matching a man, MIKE bails 6 yards into the low hole as the designated "Rat," reading the quarterback’s eyes while DBs trail the crossers.

beats.title: The Mesh Rub Baited (Interception)
beats.text: The QB spots H clearing the Mesh rub and fires into the middle, but the lurking MIKE steps directly into the throwing lane to intercept the pass.

beats.title: Defensive Return Underway
beats.text: With DBs in man coverage already sealing their receivers, the MIKE turns the interception upfield for a huge turnover return.

relations.tell: Middle linebacker mugs A-gap then immediately drops to 6 yards depth as a free-floating lurker while DBs play tight trail man
